answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Every claim climbs the violet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the plume re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the saffron of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
